findings.issue: Qal imperative 2ms of the vengeance verb is rendered as 3rd-person “Venga” (venir): the addressee is no longer commanded to avenge, and the verb means “come”.
With “Venga”, “desde los midyanitas” reads as the Midianites being the origin that sends the vengeance. מֵאֵת only licenses “from” plus the definite gentilic.

notes: נקמת בני ישראל, אחר, niphal 2ms אסף, and אל־עמיך match venganza de hijos de Israel, después, serás recogido, and a tus pueblos.
